name: crate-music-importer
title: Crate Music Importer
description: Search albums, import playlist links, and monitor Spotify-to-Music jobs.
author: elijahsanner

commands.name: browse-import-albums
commands.title: Albums Browse & Import
commands.subtitle: Crate Music Importer
commands.description: Search Spotify, preview album tracks, and queue a confirmed Music import.

commands.name: import-playlist-link
commands.title: Playlist Link Import
commands.subtitle: Crate Music Importer
commands.description: Preview a public Spotify playlist link before downloading and adding it to Music.

commands.name: import-activity-problems
commands.title: Review Activity & Problems
commands.subtitle: Crate Music Importer
commands.description: Monitor durable import progress and resolve tracks that need attention.

commands.name: update-dependencies
commands.title: Library Health & Updates
commands.subtitle: Crate Music Importer
commands.description: Run a read-only library audit and check for safe, stable downloader updates.

scripts.build: npm run prepare-backend && ray build -e dist

preferences.name: spotifyClientId
preferences.title: Spotify Client ID
preferences.description: Your own Spotify developer-app Client ID. Required for album search; see README for redirect setup.

preferences.name: managedMusicDirectory
preferences.title: Managed Music Directory
preferences.description: Default: ~/Music/mp3 Music. Keep the same folder for existing imports.

preferences.name: repositoryPath
preferences.title: Repository Folder
preferences.description: Optional development checkout. By default the extension uses its bundled backend.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: CLI Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to an installed crate-music-importer CLI; must support --raycast.

preferences.name: pythonPath
preferences.title: Python Executable
preferences.description: Python 3.10+ with mutagen installed. Auto-discovers Homebrew Python if blank.
